findings.message: 6 raw data blocks are not read to their end; in the first, the ICS Info at 0x27 sets predictor_data_present, which AAC LC does not define.
The ICS Info at 0x3A gives max_sfb 61, more than the 49 scalefactor bands of its window at 44100 Hz; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
2 raw data blocks are not read to their end; in the first, the raw data block at 0x57 ends before its END element.
The Section Data at 0xE7 has a section that ends at band 16, past max_sfb 1; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
10 samples of track 1 lie outside every mdat box, the first at 0x24.
